industry.structure: Endpoint and cloud security software is concentrated among a few scaled vendors (CrowdStrike, Microsoft, Palo Alto Networks, SentinelOne) competing on platform breadth, detection efficacy, and total cost of ownership.
industry.share_shift: CrowdStrike gained share through cloud-native Falcon adoption, but Microsoft bundling and the 2024 incident created renewal friction in enterprise accounts.
industry.trend: Consolidation toward unified security platforms (endpoint + identity + SIEM); AI-assisted detection is table stakes; buyers scrutinize operational resilience after high-profile outages.
